form.current-chamber: IN THE SENATE OF THE UNITED STATES

action.action-desc: Mr. Cruz (for himself, Mr. Hagerty, and Mr. Rounds) introduced the following bill; which was read twice and referred to the Committee on Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs

form.official-title: To prohibit the Securities and Exchange Commission from finalizing, implementing, or enforcing a proposed rule with respect to conflicts of interest associated with the use of predictive data analytics by broker-dealers and investment advisers, and for other purposes.

section.text: This Act may be cited as the Protecting Innovation in Investment Act.

section.header: Prohibition against finalizing, implementing, or enforcing a proposed rule with respect to conflicts of interest associated with the use of predictive data analytics by broker-dealers and investment advisers
section.text: The Securities and Exchange Commission may not finalize, implement, or enforce—

paragraph.text: the proposed rule of the Commission entitled Conflicts of Interest Associated With the Use of Predictive Data Analytics by Broker-Dealers and Investment Advisers (88 Fed. Reg. 53960 (August 9, 2023)); or
any rule that is substantially similar to the rule described in paragraph (1).
